doc_title: APPLICATION FOR THE REMOVAL OF THE NAME OF A DECEASED JOINT PROPRIETOR FROM THE REGISTER
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR THE REMOVAL OF THE NAME OF A DECEASED JOINT PROPRIETOR FROM THE REGISTER
when_used: The surviving joint proprietors apply to have a deceased joint proprietor's name removed from the register so that they alone remain registered.

body_text.text: The Applicant (s) being the Surviving Joint Proprietor(s) HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar to remove the name of the above Deceased Joint Proprietor from the Register of the above-mentioned Title to the intent that the Surviving Joint Proprietor(s) shall be registered as the sole proprietor(s) of the above-noted property.
The Proprietor(s) HEREBY PRODUCES for registration by the Land Registrar a certified copy of the Death Certificate of the Deceased Joint Proprietor.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this application is duly signed by the Applicant surviving Joint Proprietor(s).

registry_block: REGISTERED and SEALED this …………… day of …….……. 20……..
foot_notes: **The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
